rows.grounds: first-person present expression of devotional service
qualifies the totality of prosperity sought; first member of compound with sampattyai
denotes the purpose or benefit for which service is offered
names the mahāvidyā who is the object of service
qualifies the nature of what is bestowed; first member of compound with pradām
attributes the granting of auspicious benefit to Chinnamasta

items.question: What complete prosperity does devoted service to Chinnamasta secure for the practitioner?
premises: The speaker performs devotional service to Chinnamasta.
Chinnamasta is characterized as a bestower of auspiciousness.
The stated aim of this service is the attainment of all prosperity.
items.inference: Therefore, serving Chinnamasta is presented as the means to obtain complete and auspicious prosperity.
uncertainties: The scope of sakala-sampatti (material, spiritual, or both) is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: I serve Chinnamasta, the bestower of auspiciousness, for the sake of all prosperity.
